spine: 1. 首頁宣稱 Full ACID 與 TLA+ 證明；報告測了 1.1.4 至 1.1.18.11.rc-22，列出 96 項問題，結論是宣稱 somewhat premature。
2. 反直覺的事實：除三項外，其餘都出現在健康的單節點；到 rc-22 除十項外都已解決，卻仍掉已確認的寫入。
3. 假說一（早期版本粗糙）：查詢與約束類問題確實在 1.1.18.9 前被修掉，但 rc-22 仍有新問題，Orkes 事後的預發行說法與測試期文件不符。
4. 假說二（要有故障才壞）：故障案例（#108、#112、#107）是少數；預設 occ 與 serializable 在正常運作下就掉資料或讀到舊值。
5. 假說三（單一模式的問題）：#110 同時點名五個模式；模式名稱在文件中改名或消失，無法確定是移除還是改名。
6. 剩下的解釋落在 QA、文件與 LLM 開發取捨，但報告只呈現相容的證據，沒有證明因果；本文標為推測。
7. 未解之處：複寫未測、rc-22 之後的修復（rc.10、rc.12、rc.13）未經獨立驗證、TLA+ 規格從未提供。

perspective.mechanism: 報告把問題依類別（述詞、約束、連接、殭屍列、交易異常、故障）與版本範圍列出，讓讀者看到哪類 bug 隨版本消失、哪類留下。
perspective.tradeoff: 單節點、無複寫的測試範圍換來可重現性，但 rc-22 之後的修復與複寫行為都無法由此報告判斷；廠商資助與廠商事後說法需分開看。
perspective.reader_use: 評估宣稱 ACID 的資料庫時，先查獨立測試涵蓋的版本與預設模式，不以首頁宣稱或形式化證明的說法為準。

notes.quote: ParticleDB is a multi-model database designed for AI workloads.
notes.interpretation: 報告開頭對 ParticleDB 的定位。

notes.quote: We tested versions 1.1.4 through 1.1.18.11.rc-22 and found that ParticleDB's claims of "Full ACID" were somewhat premature.
notes.interpretation: 測試版本範圍與總結論。

notes.quote: We present 96 issues in ParticleDB, ranging from the pedestrian (crashes, deadlocks, data loss, etc.) to the piquant
notes.interpretation: 問題總數 96。

notes.quote: By version 1.1.18.11.rc-22, all but ten of those issues appeared resolved.
notes.interpretation: appeared resolved，是看起來解決，非保證。

notes.quote: This research was funded by Orkes, Inc., and conducted in accordance with the Jepsen ethics policy.
notes.interpretation: 資助來源。

notes.quote: ParticleDB's home page proudly claimed "Full ACID. 159K TPS."
notes.interpretation: 首頁宣稱。

notes.quote: However, during our collaboration no TLA+ specification was available.
notes.interpretation: formally proven 的 TLA+ 證明在合作期間沒有規格可看。

notes.quote: The TLA+ proof was not published, and in any event did not prevent disaster.
notes.interpretation: 文件章節對證明的評語。

notes.quote: The builds Orkes provided did not support replication, so this report covers only single-node behavior.
notes.interpretation: 範圍限制：單節點。

notes.quote: All but three of these issues occurred in healthy, single-node instances of ParticleDB.
notes.interpretation: 93 項不需故障；3 項在故障下。

notes.quote: While 1.1.18.11.rc-22 was significantly safer than 1.1.4, we were still finding new issues.
notes.interpretation: rc-22 仍有新問題。

notes.quote: The default `occ` mode regularly lost data in normal operation (#110).
notes.interpretation: 預設 occ 在正常運作下規律掉資料。

notes.quote: The new `serializable` mode appeared significantly safer, but still allowed stale read (#109) in normal operation
notes.interpretation: serializable 仍有 stale read；約每 300,000 個交易一次（約 80 txn/s、10 clients，摘要來源）。每小時一次是作者換算，已標為推算。

notes.quote: When we killed ParticleDB, it allowed internal anomalies, P4 (Lost Update), and G-single (#107)
notes.interpretation: 殺行程 rc-18 出現的異常。

notes.quote: would occasionally discard acknowledged writes.
notes.interpretation: #110 於 rc-18 至 rc-22，涵蓋 occ-v3、zero-copy-occ、table-2pl、serializable-ssi；一次測試約 20,000 個 key 中 31 個丟寫入。

notes.quote: Out of approximately 20,000 keys, 31 lost writes.
notes.interpretation: 單次測試的數字，非通則。

notes.quote: ParticleDB would discover that its data files were corrupt, then start up anyway, serving data to clients.
notes.interpretation: #108；一次測試 44 個元素重啟後消失，rc-22 上 #112 洗亂 13 個 4 KB 區塊後忘掉所有資料表。

notes.quote: Any writes performed by the enclosing transaction would be lost.
it left a shadow of the table behind, whose rows would reappear in later tables with the same name
notes.interpretation: #46 dropped table 殘影，浮點 18.83 變 19；rc-3 修復（Orkes 說）。

notes.quote: It is not clear whether these modes were removed or simply renamed.
notes.interpretation: 文件稱 occ-v3 與 strict-serializable 為 earlier names，並稱模式為 experimental；rc-22 起 table-2pl 與 serializable-ssi 不在（摘要來源）；操作手冊的模式對應模型（occ-v3 對應 SI 等）亦出自摘要。

notes.quote: unsupported pre-release builds
notes.interpretation: Orkes 事後對 1.1.4 至 rc-22 的稱呼；報告指出測試當時文件沒有這樣標示（摘要來源，轉述）。

notes.quote: The replication system remains to be tested.
notes.interpretation: 未測範圍；另有磁碟儲存、Redis 與 HTTP API、時間地理空間、物化視圖、向量搜尋、多租戶、Particles 預存程序（摘要來源）。

notes.quote: Orkes claims that all issues from this report have been addressed as of version 1.1.19-rc.13.
Jepsen has not evaluated versions of ParticleDB after 1.1.18.11.rc-22
notes.interpretation: 後續修復未獨立驗證。

notes.quote: 1087x faster than PostgreSQL
notes.interpretation: 網站宣稱的倍數；報告說實測遠不及，且一小時內吞吐量下降、延遲上升（摘要轉述，非逐字）。

notes.quote: formally proven
notes.interpretation: 首頁對 TLA+ 證明的宣稱用語。

notes.quote: to the piquant (partially-invisible rows which could not be deleted, `WHERE 4 = 5`
notes.interpretation: 摘要列舉的 piquant 問題；另含資料表重現、欄位混淆、字串變整數（#46、#77、#37）。

notes.quote: Most issues required just a single server, single client, and no faults.
notes.interpretation: 多數問題無需故障；『照文件開實例就可能碰到』是作者推測，文中已標。

notes.quote: Orkes engaged Jepsen to test these versions of ParticleDB, beginning with 1.1.4.
notes.interpretation: 委託從 1.1.4 開始；『多數修復在回報後』是作者從時間順序推測，文中已標。

notes.quote: ParticleDB continued to lose committed writes during normal operation with the default `occ` transaction mode
notes.interpretation: 預設 occ 在最後測試仍丟已提交寫入（#110）。

notes.quote: the documentation did not explain what these modes actually guaranteed
notes.interpretation: 第 1.1 節：文件未說明各模式保證什麼。

notes.quote: over the course of an hour we observed a linear decline in throughput and a significant increase in median latencies
notes.interpretation: 效能隨時間惡化；同段另有 'In our tests ParticleDB was nowhere near this fast' 與 'ParticleDB claimed to be 1087x faster than PostgreSQL'。

notes.quote: Jepsen recommends users halt further deployment of ParticleDB and migrate to other databases as soon as possible.
notes.interpretation: 報告的建議；另有 'Consider checking and/or rebuilding database state from more reliable sources, if available.'

notes.quote: possibly
notes.interpretation: QA 與 LLM 依賴的推論用保留語氣；Orkes 說跑過 Jepsen 的 Postgres 框架與 SQLancer，框架卻在 1.1.4 立即失敗；LLM 取捨一節描述 Orkes 難以解釋多數 ParticleDB 問題、新版本無 changelog（皆摘要轉述）。作者將流程解釋標為推測。

claims.claim_text: LLM 讓小團隊能快速建出複雜的分散式 SQL 資料庫，但品質付出代價：許多正確性錯誤，工具還反覆宣稱修好了其實沒修好的東西。Orkes 能解釋大多數 Conductor 的 bug，卻似乎說不清楚幾乎每一項 ParticleDB 問題的成因與修法，新版本出現時也沒有 changelog。
claims.evidence: Large Language Models enable small teams to produce software and documentation of staggering scope and complexity. / Quality suffered: ParticleDB was a fractal of correctness errors. / LLM tooling repeatedly claimed that bugs had been fixed when, in fact, they had not. / As with most Jepsen analyses, Orkes engineers offered detailed explanations of the causes and resolutions of the bugs ... we found in Conductor. / However, Orkes seemed unable to explain the causes or resolutions of nearly every issue we found in ParticleDB. / New builds simply materialized, sans changelogs
claims.note: Post also hedges: 'No causal proof' is the post's own statement; report frames it as 'serious tradeoffs'.

claims.claim_text: ParticleDB 自稱「1087x faster than PostgreSQL」，實測的結論是「In our tests ParticleDB was nowhere near this fast」，並且「over the course of an hour we observed a linear decline in throughput and a significant increase in median latencies」。
claims.location: 收斂後效能段 與 figure 第三列
claims.evidence: ParticleDB claimed to be "1087x faster than PostgreSQL". / In our tests ParticleDB was nowhere near this fast, and over the course of an hour we observed a linear decline [in throughput and a significant increase in median latencies] (4.6 Future Work)
claims.note: Tool excerpt truncated after 'linear decline'; remainder matches author note n33. Source says 'ParticleDB claimed'; the figure's label '網站宣稱' (website) is a small specificity step not confirmed here. Earlier worry that the quote was summary-only is resolved: it is verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 「除了十項之外都已解決」...原文用的字眼是 appeared resolved，...報告同時說明 Jepsen 沒有評估 rc-22 之後的任何版本。
claims.evidence: By version 1.1.18.11.rc-22, all but ten of those issues appeared resolved. / Jepsen has not evaluated versions of ParticleDB after 1.1.18.11.rc-22

claims.claim_text: 「The replication system remains to be tested」；磁碟儲存需要更多測試，Redis 與 HTTP API、時間與地理空間查詢、物化檢視、向量搜尋、多租戶也都沒碰。Python 與 Rust 的預存程序（Particles）正在加入，報告說值得調查。
claims.evidence: The replication system remains to be tested. / ParticleDB's Redis or HTTP APIs, temporal or geospatial queries, materialized views, vector search, or multi-tenant features. / further tests should stress on-disk storage more thoroughly. / Orkes is now adding stored procedures to ParticleDB. ... written in Python or Rust ... Our previous work with stored procedures suggests this feature is worth further investigation.

claims.claim_text: 「Orkes claims that all issues from this report have been addressed as of version 1.1.19-rc.13」；#109 rc.10；#107、#108、#112 rc.12；#110 與 #73 rc.13；「Jepsen has not evaluated versions of ParticleDB after 1.1.18.11.rc-22」；#108 偵測位元翻轉並拒絕啟動
claims.evidence: However, Orkes claims that all issues from this report have been addressed as of version 1.1.19-rc.13. / Orkes reported that version 1.1.19-rc.10 no longer exhibits stale read [#109] / Orkes claims this issue (#107) was resolved in version 1.1.19-rc.12. / Orkes reports 1.1.19-rc.12 detects bitflips correctly and refuses to start. [#108] / Orkes released version 1.1.19-rc.12; they believe it resolves this issue [#112] / Orkes released version 1.1.19-rc.13, and believes that it fixes this issue [#110] / Orkes reports version 1.1.19-rc.13 no longer exhibits G-Single. [#73] / Jepsen has not evaluated versions of ParticleDB after 1.1.18.11.rc-22

claims.claim_text: 報告對已測版本的使用者給的建議是停止部署、遷移到其他資料庫，並盡可能用更可靠的來源檢查或重建資料庫狀態，同時註明 Jepsen 無法證明沒有 bug。
claims.evidence: Jepsen recommends users halt further deployment of ParticleDB and migrate to other databases as soon as possible. / Consider checking and/or rebuilding database state from more reliable sources, if available. / we cannot prove correctness.
claims.note: 'cannot prove correctness' is close to, not identical to, 'cannot prove absence of bugs'; acceptable paraphrase.
